subject: Re: MedLytics clinic RFP - side-by-side evaluation credits
messages:
From: Tara Singh <tara@medlytics.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: procure@medlytics.com
Date: 2028-02-09T08:14:00-08:00
Subject: MedLytics clinic RFP — evaluation credits request

Hi Soojin / Karthik,

Thanks for the demo last week — the team liked the latency profile and the runtime controls. We're running a formal side-by-side bake-off next month as part of the RFP (competitor: NLPWorks). The procurement team asked whether Redwood can provide promotional evaluation credits and a short trial extension so we can complete security and integration tests in parallel.

Attached is the RFP summary and scope (MedLytics_RFP_2028-02.pdf). High-level asks: 1) 90–120 day evaluation window, 2) credit pool to cover ~300k tokens or equivalent compute for the core clinical extraction pipeline, 3) access to a solution engineer for a two-week onboard sprint.

Can you confirm if Redwood can support a package like that and any constraints we should be aware of? Procurement is on a tight cadence — would like a numbers/terms answer by EOD Wednesday.

Thanks,
Tara Singh
Procurement Lead — MedLytics
procure@medlytics.com

Attachment: MedLytics_RFP_2028-02.pdf (application/pdf, 1 page)

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Tara Singh <tara@medlytics.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-02-09T11:20:00-08:00
Subject: Re: MedLytics clinic RFP — evaluation credits request

Hi Tara — great to hear the demo resonated. Appreciate the RFP doc.

Short answer: we can support a tailored evaluation package for RFP bake-offs. Proposed starter package (subject to final approvals):
- 250k token evaluation credit (can be issued as a billed credit against the account)
- 90-day trial window (we can extend to 120 days on a case-by-case basis with program approval)
- 4-day onboarding with an assigned Solutions Engineer + 10 hours of hands-on support for integration tests

Request from our side: a brief mutual action plan (MAP) listing success criteria and a 30/60/90 testing cadence so we can map quota and SE time. If you confirm interest, I'll loop in legal and Marissa for final sign-off and DocuSign addendum.

On logistics: we commonly cap promotional credits to avoid abuse; if MedLytics needs more than 250k tokens to match a competitor offer, please say so and we can escalate. Also attaching a security questionnaire pre-fill to speed SOC review.

Thanks — Soojin
So,
Sojin Lee
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachment: Redwood_Security_Questionnaire_2028-02.pdf (application/pdf, 3 pages)

From: Tara Singh <tara@medlytics.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@medlytics.com>, procure@medlytics.com
Date: 2028-02-10T09:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: MedLytics clinic RFP — evaluation credits request

Thanks Soojin — helpful. Two quick follow-ups: 1) NLPWorks has offered 300k tokens + a 120-day window in their commercial offer, so to give Redwood a fair shot we need parity on token pool or a clear value equivalent; 2) Security will need the completed questionnaire and evidence of audit logs retention for 90 days.

If Redwood can meet 300k tokens and confirm the security items (audit logs + retention policy), we can present Redwood as a vendor to the clinical review board next week. Can you escalate for an additional 50k tokens?

Onboard SE time and MAP look fine — Sanjay (cc'd) will be our product lead for the evaluation.

Best,
Tara

"On Fri, Feb 9, 2028 at 8:14 AM Tara Singh <tara@medlytics.com> wrote:
> Hi Soojin / Karthik,
> 
> Thanks for the demo last week — the team liked the latency profile...
>

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-02-11T14:30:00-08:00
Subject: FW: MedLytics clinic RFP — escalation for extra credits

Soojin / Marissa — looping you both for approval. MedLytics is asking for 300k tokens to match NLPWorks; they flagged security evidence as a gating item. My read: this is a close enterprise opportunity (clinical customer, strategic vertical) and the cost of the uplift is modest relative to potential ARR. Proposed counter (compromise):
- Approve 250k tokens immediately (fast delivery) + a conditional top-up of 50k tokens if MedLytics completes the MAP milestones and the clinical board moves them to phase 2 (i.e., pay-for-success trigger)
- Trial window set to 90 days with a documented option to extend to 120 days upon product validation
- Require signed addendum with a clause for credit recovery/bill-back if usage is abusive or outside the scope of the evaluation

Please confirm — if you approve, I'll draft the short addendum and send for DocuSign. Also recommend we provide the security evidence they asked for (audit log retention policy + SOC pointer) alongside the offer.

-Karthik
Director, Solutions & Partnerships

(Quoted: Tara's ask for 300k tokens and details)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Tara Singh <tara@medlytics.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-02-13T16:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: MedLytics clinic RFP — evaluation credits request (approved)

Hi Tara — thanks for the clear ask and for sharing Sanjay. We've reviewed internally and are prepared to move forward with the following official offer:

- Promotional credit: 250,000 tokens issued to MedLytics account upon signed addendum.
- Conditional top-up: additional 50,000 tokens unlocked if MedLytics signs the MAP and completes the Stage 1 acceptance criteria within 90 days (defined in MAP).
- Evaluation window: 90 days; a one-time extension to 120 days can be granted upon request and review of MAP progress.
- Support: assignment of a Solutions Engineer for the initial 2-week onboarding + up to 10 hours of follow-on integration support.
- Security: attaching the Redwood security questionnaire and our audit log retention statement. Please review and confirm.
- Terms: addendum will include a clause for credit recovery if credits are used outside the agreed evaluation scope.

Action items for MedLytics to accept the offer: 1) Sign the short addendum via DocuSign (link below), 2) Submit the MAP doc (30/60/90 milestones), 3) Confirm the contact for SE scheduling (Sanjay ok?).

DocuSign: https://docusign.com/usa/send/abcdef123456
MAP template (drive): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-macrop

If that aligns, we'll prepare the credit and SE schedule immediately after the addendum is signed.

Best regards,
Marissa Cole
VP, Sales Operations — Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Attachments: Redwood_Security_Questionnaire_2028-02.pdf; Audit_Log_Retention_Statement.txt
